name: review-room
description: Agent-controlled adversarial reviews with local harnesses and a native discussion panel.

interface.longDescription: Your chat agent coordinates read-only code reviews with Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi. Browse review cards, follow reviewer conversations, and collect Markdown reports. Native settings control enabled models, review limits, and session reuse.
interface.defaultPrompt: Run an adversarial review of my current changes using Review Room.
